ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type.
description: **Ocean Model Horizontal Grid Description:** The ocean component uses a tripolar horizontal grid with a uniform longitudinal resolution of 1.0° (spanning -280° to 80°). In latitude, the grid spacing varies smoothly: it is set to 0.25° in the equatorial region (10°S–10°N), increasing uniformly to 1.0° in mid-latitudes at 45°S and 45°N, and then refining gradually to 0.5° toward the poles (-90° and 90°). The tripolar fold is joined at 65°N.
